Field
Description
ContextProcessId UPID of process originating this event.
FileIdentifier
File identified on the Windows system that is used to match with the ArchiveFileContent event to show archive content in User Activities.
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
SHA256HashData
The SHA256 hash of a file. In most cases, the hash of the file referred to by the ImageFileName field.
